items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Board of Directors Open Meeting Minutes, May 25, 2023
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health’s Board accepted the resignation of Rajesh (Raj) Uttamchandani, effective April 2023. The resignation was formally recorded by the Board’s Governance Committee and accepted at the May 25, 2023 Board meeting.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Board of Directors Open Meeting Minutes
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey joined the Mackenzie Health Board for a three-year term in October 2023. The Governance Committee recommended his election at a special members meeting, alongside Jack Mintz.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Board of Directors Open Meeting Minutes
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Jack Mintz was recommended and elected to a three-year term on the Mackenzie Health Board in October 2023, at the same special members meeting that brought John Fursey onto the Board.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, announcement of new Board chairs
items.verbatim_snippet: Stephanie Zee became Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board at the organization’s June 13, 2024 Annual General Meeting, succeeding Fay Lim-Lambie.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, announcement of new Board chairs
items.verbatim_snippet: Stephanie Zee became Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board at the organization’s June 13, 2024 Annual General Meeting, succeeding Fay Lim-Lambie. Zee had been a Board member since 2016 and had served as Vice-Chair since 2021, as well as leading Finance and Audit and Governance work.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Board announcement and AGM minutes
items.verbatim_snippet: Following the 2024 AGM, Ruby Philip-Katyal was appointed Vice-Chair and Dr. Joby McKenzie Second Vice-Chair for the 2024–25 Board term.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Board announcement and AGM minutes
items.verbatim_snippet: Following the 2024 AGM, Ruby Philip-Katyal was appointed Vice-Chair and Dr. Joby McKenzie Second Vice-Chair for the 2024–25 Board term.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, "A leadership update from Mackenzie Health"
items.verbatim_snippet: After more than 14 years as President and CEO, Altaf Stationwala announced in late March 2025 that he would leave Mackenzie Health to become President and CEO of Unity Health Toronto. His final day at Mackenzie Health was June 27, 2025, with the move to Unity Health effective July 1.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health leadership announcement and organizational structure
items.verbatim_snippet: Mary-Agnes Wilson, previously Mackenzie Health’s Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Nursing Executive, was appointed Interim President and CEO during the CEO transition following Stationwala’s departure.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, "Welcoming the new Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors"
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at the June 19, 2025 AGM, succeeding Stephanie Zee.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, "Welcoming the new Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors"
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at the June 19, 2025 AGM, succeeding Stephanie Zee. Fursey had joined the Board in 2023 and had served in major governance and finance-related capacities.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health Board announcement / 2024–25 Community Report
items.verbatim_snippet: At the 2025 Board transition, Mackenzie Health identified Fay Lim-Lambie and Ruby Philip-Katyal as outgoing directors. Both had been significant governance leaders: Lim-Lambie had served as Board Chair and Philip-Katyal as Vice-Chair.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, 2025 Board minutes
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Jun Yuan was recommended for election to a three-year term at the 2025 Mackenzie Health members meeting. The Board’s May 29 minutes identify him as a new incoming director, and the subsequent Board roster lists him as a member.

items.role: Interim Executive Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Corporate Organizational Structure
items.verbatim_snippet: Heather Stewart became Interim Executive Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive as part of the post-CEO-transition leadership structure. The July 2, 2025 organizational chart identifies Stewart in the interim EVP/CNE role.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, "Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new Chief of Staff"
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. David Rauchwerger was appointed Mackenzie Health’s new Chief of Staff, effective December 15, 2025, succeeding Dr. Steven Jackson, who had held the Chief of Staff role for approximately a decade.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, Chief of Staff succession announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. Steven Jackson stepped down as Chief of Staff after roughly 10 years in the position when David Rauchwerger assumed the role on December 15, 2025.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, "Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new President and CEO"
items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo was appointed Mackenzie Health’s new President and CEO, effective April 13, 2026, succeeding interim CEO Mary-Agnes Wilson.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, April 2026 leadership communication / organizational structure
items.verbatim_snippet: On April 13, 2026, Mary-Agnes Wilson’s interim CEO period concluded and Carmine Stumpo formally assumed the permanent President and CEO role.

items.role: Vice President of People Services and Chief Human Resources Officer
items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health, December 2025 Insider
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health announced in December 2025 that Stav D’Andrea, Vice President of People Services and Chief Human Resources Officer, would retire in February 2026 after more than 10 years with the organization.
